pages.text: This module adds new decorative building blocks and improves vanilla ones.

pages.title: Bookshelves
pages.text: Craft bookshelves from any wood type.

pages.title: Buttons and Plates
pages.text: Craft buttons and pressure plates from any wood type.

pages.title: Chests
pages.text: Craft chests from any wood type.

pages.title: Blaze Lantern
pages.text: Crafted from 5 blaze powder and 4 blaze rods.

pages.title: Charcoal Block
pages.text: Like netherrack, fire burns forever on it.

pages.title: Glass Item Frames
pages.text: Crafted from an item frame and 8 glass panes.

pages.title: Iron Ladders
pages.text: Crafted from 6 iron rods.

pages.title: More Banner Layers
pages.text: Banners now support up to 16 layers instead of 6.

pages.title: New Patterns
pages.text: New materials can be used for banner patterns.

pages.title: Paper Lantern
pages.text: Crafted from paper, sticks, and glowstone.

pages.title: Paper Walls
pages.text: Crafted from paper, sticks, and a sapling.

pages.title: Placeable Blaze Rods
pages.text: Blaze rods can be placed in the world.

pages.title: Lead Connections
pages.text: Fences can now be connected to each other with leads.

pages.title: Better Flower Pots
pages.text: Flower pots now accept almost any type of vegetation.
Right-click the composter with organic items to add them. When full, you will receive bone meal.

pages.title: Custom Bed Covers
pages.text: You can remove a banner from a bed by placing it back into a crafting table.

pages.title: Sign Pictures
pages.text: You can place signs displaying custom pictures and GIFs.$(br2)1. Press the $(k:signpic.key.gui) key.$(br2)2. Paste the image URL (preferably Imgur) or file path.$(br2)3. Click "Place".$(br2)4. Place the sign!

pages.title: Sign Pictures
pages.text: UwU

pages.title: Bookshelf Chest
pages.text: A bookshelf with 9 slots for storing books. Provides the same enchanting power as a standard bookshelf as long as it contains at least one book.
